about:
I'm a software developer and artist-researcher based in Montreal.

I build computers for agents: machines that autonomous software can inhabit for a long time. My part is core storage: the state that has to survive.

I treat systems and protocols as environments: the work is a set of rules, and the art is what happens when people and machines follow them.

Before all this, I planted over a million trees. Each one went into one particular patch of ground. I think of software the same way: site-specific, in situ.
projects_A:
Tell your AI agent to read `portfolio.md` for a short selection of current projects. Go to [vincentcharlebois.net](https://vincentcharlebois.net) for earlier research-driven work and [vincent.charlebois.info](https://vincent.charlebois.info/en/) for my artist profile.

What is running right now:

- Every photo on my phone, published only as words.
- A model that slowly deletes its own origin, until nothing is left.
- An AI that writes instructions a person must carry out, then prove.
- Agents that negotiate what an artwork is worth.
contact_A:
